observation.command: echo 50 > /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cpu.weight 2>&1; echo "cpu.weight rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cpu.weight; echo ---; echo 90 > /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cpu.weight 2>&1; echo "probe rc=$?"; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/probe/cpu.weight; echo ---; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/buildkit/cpu.weight 2>/dev/null
